messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads-up — during vuln triage we found two customers that could potentially read tenant audit events via an internal tooling bug. Need quick alignment on access controls and customer-facing validation.

ashwin (eng-security): Oof. Do we have repro steps or logs?

maria (sec-eng): repro attached in the vuln ticket, but short version: an export endpoint incorrectly applied org-level filters for scoped tokens. It returned audit rows with tenant_id for other tenants when token was scoped to org admins.

sre-bot: ALERT: export-service 503 -> retry logic triggered for 3 requests (related ticket #4567).

jordan (platform): If the scoped token check is wrong + export query lacks tenant predicate, that's two problems. We should treat this as P1 customer-facing risk.

kyle (sre): Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) disable export endpoint for org-scoped tokens, 2) revoke any long-lived scoped tokens created in last 24h, 3) rotate signing keys for export webhook. Can someone run the revokes?

elaine (infra): On KMS: rotating signing keys is non-trivial for customers who verify events. We need to publish signed-key fingerprints and a migration window. Also we can add event signatures per-tenant using tenant-specific KMS wrapping to reduce blast radius.

ashwin (eng-security): We should also validate the audit event schema for consumer-facing exports — include a required attribute `tenant_claim` in the JWT and mirrored `tenant_id` in every exported event. If they diverge, reject. Example check: ```if event.tenant_id != jwt.claims.tenant_claim: drop_event()```

maria (sec-eng): +1. That gives us deterministic validation for customer exports. Also we need RBAC rule clarification: org_admin vs tenant_admin vs member. Currently product docs are fuzzy about who gets audit exports.

jordan (platform): Proposal: update RBAC so `audit:export` is only granted to `tenant_admin` by default. `org_admin` can request a time-bound `audit:org_export` with explicit justification + reviewed by compliance. We'll implement via scoped token scopes, e.g., `scopes=["audit:export", "audit:org_export:ttl=1h"]`.

kyle (sre): For immediate response: i've posted a short mitigation playbook in the runbook channel and toggled the feature flag to block org-scoped exports.

elaine (infra): For KMS integration timeline: I can prototype per-tenant key wrapping in 48h, but publishing key fingerprints & a signed metadata endpoint will be needed for customers to trust rotated keys.

ashwin (eng-security): On schema changes: add `event.schema_version`, `tenant_id`, `tenant_claim`, `signed_by_key_id`. Bump to v2 for exports. We'll reject any v1 export if the export token contains `scope=tenant` mismatch.

maria (sec-eng): Action items: 1) ashwin -> write validation middleware PR that rejects event exports where tenant mismatch; 2) jordan -> update RBAC defaults and scoped token issuance rules; 3) elaine -> publish key fingerprint endpoint + temp rotate plan; 4) kyle -> revoke tokens and keep feature flag. Aim for hotfix deploy within 6 hours.

ashwin (eng-security): I'll open the PR and link tests; include unit tests for edge cases where `tenant_id` is null or event uses legacy schema.

jordan (platform): I'll update the token issuance service to append `audit:org_export:ttl` only when a 2nd factor justification tag present. Will add telemetry for any token that includes an audit scope.

kyle (sre): Also recommend adding an audit consumer sandbox where customers can validate event signatures after key rotations — prevents finger-pointing.

maria (sec-eng): Good call. For now I'll notify affected customers with the minimal statement and a timeline for remediation. Keep thread updated when revokes and PRs land. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: DEPLOYMENT: feature-flag toggle blocked for org-exports by kyle at 2209990300.

ashwin (eng-security): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/export-validation/pull/89. Tests included.

jordan (platform): Token service patch queued for review. ETA 3h.

elaine (infra): Key fingerprint endpoint: https://kms.internal/keys/audit-fingerprints available (draft). Will promote after review.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks all. We'll follow up in incident-ops if anything customer-impacting emerges.
